scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n engine,web,api -c teal,cyan,orange "npm run dev -w @chord-ai/engine" "npm run dev -w @chord-ai/web" "npm run dev -w @chord-ai/worker"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @chord-ai/engine && npm run build -w @chord-ai/web && npm run build -w @chord-ai/worker
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply chord-ai --local --persist-to worker/.wrangler/state
scripts.deploy:dry: npm run build && node scripts/ensure-web-dist.mjs && echo "Run: wrangler deploy (requires Cloudflare credentials)"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @chord-ai/engine && npm run typecheck -w @chord-ai/web && npm run typecheck -w @chord-ai/worker
